نقترف (form VIII)
# نَقْتَرِفُ (naqtarifu) /naq.ta.ri.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# نُقْتَرَفُ (nuqtarafu) /nuq.ta.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# نَقْتَرِفَ (naqtarifa) /naq.ta.ri.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# نُقْتَرَفَ (nuqtarafa) /nuq.ta.ra.fa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
